Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The study employs two distinct MS approaches: 1) Targeted PRM for specific phosphopeptide quantification following TiO2 enrichment, and 2) DDA (TOP15) for the discovery of the FLNc d18-21 interactome via AP-MS. Both are label-free. The primary focus is on phosphorylation sites S2233/S2236 (human) / S2234/S2237 (mouse).

scope: For pulldown experiments of FLNc d18-21 and FLNc d1-3 (the latter serving as control), FLNc d18-21-His-EEF and FLNc d1-3-His were recombinantly expressed in E.coli BL21(DE3) and immobilized on Ni2+-NTA agarose beads
Immobilized FLNc d18-21 and FLNc d1-3 were washed twice with co-IP buffer, mixed with cleared C2 cell lysates, and incubated for 1 h under constant agitation at 10 °C.
To elute proteins bound to the beads, SDS sample buffer... was added and samples were boiled for 5 min at 95 °C.
Gel lanes were cut into eight slices each and processed for LC-MS analysis of the proteins

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The mass spectrometry analysis was performed on material obtained from Ni2+-NTA pulldown experiments using recombinant FLNc constructs as bait to capture interactors from C2 cell lysates.

Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The primary perturbation is mechanical stress induced via electrical pulse stimulation (EPS). The study also uses a series of small molecule inhibitors (MK-2206, OA, CalA) and activators (PDP-Nal) to probe the phosphatase/kinase balance. The matched_class_key for mechanical stress was set to fluid_shear_stress as a proxy for mechanical force, though EPS is an electrical trigger for contraction.
